sources.title: AT&T and Verizon normalize layoffs as 8,000 jobs go in a quarter
sources.description: Together, AT&T and Verizon now employ fewer people than AT&T alone did in 2020, but cuts so far seem to have had little to do with AI.

sources.title: Verizon to sell 274 stores, lay off another 500 employees
sources.description: Verizon announces plans to sell 274 retail locations and cut 500 corporate jobs as part of its restructuring efforts.

sources.title: Verizon to sell nearly 300 stores, cut 500 jobs in restructuring
sources.description: Verizon will sell nearly 300 retail stores and cut some 500 corporate jobs as part of a restructuring plan, but the closures will mean thousands more retail employees could be out of a job.

sources.title: Verizon cutting more than 13,000 jobs as it restructures
sources.description: Wireless carrier Verizon said Thursday it will cut more than 13,000 jobs in its largest single layoff as it works to shrink costs and restructure operations.

sources.title: Verizon cutting more than 13,000 jobs | Jefferson City News-Tribune
sources.description: NEW YORK (AP) -- Verizon is laying off more than 13,000 employees in mass job reductions that arrive as the telecommunications giant says it must "reorient" its entire company.
